Replaces fz-mue.41's widening (fz-mue.40 made iolist proper by the user's earlier "Recursive, proper" answer).

Folded in (user decision, 2026-11-25): IO.iodata_length/1 counts the bytes of iodata, as in Elixir. lib/io.fz does not define it. :erlang.iolist_size (lib/erlang.fz:225-248) already walks iodata, improper tails included, so it is built on that. Found by Bugs and Cleanup during this ticket's research.
title: An improper iolist is iodata, as in Elixir
